questions.stem: Which of the following statements is incorrect with respect to the role of physiological pH of the vagina?

options.text: The acidic pH of the vagina helps prevent the growth of pathogenic organisms.

options.label: B
options.text: Doderlein's bacillus is responsible for maintaining the acidic pH by converting glycogen to lactic acid under the influence of estrogen.

options.text: Doderlein's bacillus appears in the vagina 3–4 days after birth and disappears after 10–14 days, to reappear at puberty.

options.label: D
